## Custom NPC fixes

- Assigns a sit action's seat set before native initialization, avoiding false missing-seat errors while preserving seat lookup and assignment. [#381](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/381)
- Builds matching NPC behavior stacks and schedules on co-op clients, fixing RPC parsing errors and lost unlock updates when joining a running world. [#384](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/384)

## Faster NPC loading

- Reuses scene lookups and batches contact reconciliation during save loading, reducing repeated scans for large custom NPC packs. [#385](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/385)
- Caches generated mugshots on disk between loads. Changed appearance inputs, attachment textures, texture settings, game or mod builds invalidate the cache; damaged entries are regenerated. Set `EnableMugshotCache` to `false` in S1API preferences to disable it. Loading-time improvements depend on the pack and environment. [#388](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/pull/388)

## Documentation

- Removes the broken DeepWiki badge from the README.

## Compatibility and validation

Targets the regular Schedule I release line. Existing public APIs, save identifiers and network formats are retained. Mugshot caches are local to each client and unused entries expire after 30 days.

Validation includes separate Mono and IL2CPP builds and contract suites, plus live seat, NPC loading, co-op and mugshot checks recorded in the linked PRs. The mugshot follow-up was checked on both runtimes for texture invalidation, cache reuse, damaged-file recovery and save reloads.

The separate issue where clients already in the lobby miss new NPC unlock defaults when the host loads a save remains tracked in [#386](https://github.com/ifBars/S1API/issues/386).
